name: Release v2.14.3 - Order Service Refactor
body:
## Changes
- Refactored order validation logic
- Migrated to new payment gateway client
- Updated database connection pooling from 20 to 50 connections

## Authors
- @braca (order validation)
- @fedja (payment gateway)

## Risk Assessment
**Medium Risk**: Database connection pool size changed from 20 to 50. This increases load on the database server.
